newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cervecerias Unidas upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cervecerias Unidas upped.

text.p: Smith Barney analysts Francisco Chevez and George Monserrat raised their rating for Chilean brewer Compania Cervecerias Unidas Monday to outperform from neutral.
-- "Our new more-bullish stance on CCU is based on an improving operating outlook for the company over the next two years," they wrote in a report.
-- "We are holding back from a straight buy rating until we see a more positive trend in the Chilean beer market.
-- "Relative valuation on CCU has improved as the Latin American beverage sector's valuation has moved up sharply."
-- They set a price target of $30 for the American Depositary Receipts (ADRs). They raised their 1997 and 1998 estimates for earnings per ADR to $1.15 and $1.36, respectively.
-- The ADRs opened up 1/16 to 24-3/4 in New York.
